sentences.en: The threatening floods made it necessary to evacuate the town.
sentences.zh: 威胁性的洪水使得必须撤离该镇。

sentences.en: They plan to evacuate all nonessential personnel from the embassy.
sentences.zh: 他们计划从大使馆撤离所有非必要人员。

sentences.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
sentences.zh: 我们只有五分钟时间撤离整个大楼。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+vacu（空）+ate（使…）→空出去→撤离
